BOLT

UBC's Largest Data Club

Empowering UBC students to harness the power of data through hands-on workshops, case competitions, and networking events. Join us to develop practical analytics skills and connect with industry professionals.

About us

Growth and Community

Bolt provides an enriching platform that fosters collaboration, presents intellectually stimulating challenges, and facilitateshands-on experiences. This unique opportunity is open to students from diverse backgrounds, inviting them to immerse themselves in the dynamic realm of business analytics.

Our mission is to foster a growth mindset in the community and help studentsdevelop data analytics skills to be successful in their careers. Anyone with a interest for data, analytics, or tech is invited to join us on our journey.

Collaborating with leading organizations to bring real-world data experiences to our community

Events

Our Events

First Byte

Our flagship bootcamp introducing students to data analytics through hands-on projects and mentorship from industry professionals.

October

BOLT Connect

Connect with like-minded data enthusiasts, industry professionals, and alumni. Network and discover career opportunities in analytics.

November

BOLT Circuit

An intensive case competition where teams tackle real-world business problems using data analytics and present solutions to industry judges.

March

BOLT Bootcamp

An introductory workshop series for beginners covering fundamental data analysis tools, Excel, SQL, and data visualization basics.

April

Newsletter

Stay Connected

Subscribe to our newsletter for exclusive updates on upcoming events, data analytics insights, workshops, and career opportunities in the tech industry.

DataBridge

Free Data Consulting for Local Businesses

Connect with our expert data analytics team for complimentary consulting services. We help local businesses unlock the power of their data through analysis, visualization, and strategic insights.

Data Analysis

Comprehensive analysis of your business data to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities for growth.

Data Visualization

Create compelling dashboards and visualizations that make your data accessible and actionable.

Strategic Insights

Transform raw data into strategic recommendations that drive business decisions and growth.

Our team of data science students is ready to help your business thrive. Contact us for a free consultation and discover how data can transform your operations.
